title: Leaving high school; the Maroon Five and a fraternity pledge
summary: He left school at seventeen, played with college men, and was pledged Delta Tau Delta, wishing for a university education.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: A while back we were talking about your coming out of school at seventeen to join the Wolverines. And this literally meant that you did not finish highschool at that point because you left, I think you said you were in your second year I think. Almost at the end of the second year.
Now I think you've got quite a story about being a self-educated man. (LAUGHTER).
How did you go about becoming one?
I used to play a lot out at the

University of Chicago with the Maroon Five. And also went up to Lost Lake with them up in Wisconsin. A bunch of college guys. And I was naturally a highschool boy but I was pledged (Doyta Del Doyta?) and I had you know, visions of going to the University of Chicago. I wanted education naturally. Along with everything else. But going music and joining the Wolverines why that was it. I just loved music so much..... Delta Tau Delta
Now (Doyta Del Doyta?) is a college fraternity?
And you were pledged even before you got to college?
Well they liked me and they thought I'd be good and I...
They sort of tapped you as a, yes.
